method: Decoded GLTFLoader + Draco, actual AnimationMixer world transforms at 120 Hz; world plants use host reference trajectory; no authoring imports. Joint values use canonical bind axes and broad anatomical envelopes; overhead shoulder axial swing/twist becomes singular and those samples are counted explicitly. All grounded horizontal accelerations above 0.4 m/s² are evaluated; no acceleration lean is required during flight. Duplicate comparison against v8 and original motion2 uses body pose independently of ball visibility.
